items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Irving Mills told me that when you went to England that there was a reception or a party with and the King of England was there... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's right.

ctx.x: that tune he used to play, and I used to go out front and play it -- he played it, but he realized he was nervous, you know? Oh, you've got to get nervous with those kind of people out there. They are expecting so much from you, and when we first started and opened the curtain and announced Duke Ellington, the applause lasted so long, you know it's gonna shake you up.
Irving Mills told me that when you went to England that there was a reception or a party with and the King of England was there, and the whole band was there?
